summary: Front-end menu leaves on native blocks: 00686380's rewards, briefing and leaderboards constructors and 006898C0's control layout and control binding constructors run on a zeroed block of their operator new size (MenuLeafBlock in src/game_hosts_menu.cpp); the registry borrows the leaf's own +4h/+5h flags and the options leaves register as screens 0Eh/0Fh through kOptionsScreens.

rows.reason: Its two 008D7710 GameSettings edit copies need the NativeGameSettingsContext GameNativeSettingsProcess keeps private (no menu-host binding), and 008D7710 imports the signed-in profile through XLive when [00F8ABE8] is signed in; not taken without a run.

The constructor zeroes the main-menu selection cells 00E194C4..00E194D0 and raises 00E08874; no host owns those cells (MainMenuActivationBindings has no live owner) and raise_front_end_dirty_flag is a log stand-in.

Needs the [00F8D434] Lua/texture manager for 00B1BD20("white.tga") and the [00F8D39C] render resources' four ColourRemap.tga slots, plus 0093CB10 and native-string vector iterators; the menu host owns none of them.
Only caller is 005902E0 (+0Ch text listener base), skipped above.
Rewards register runs the bind virtual 0061FBE0 (widget lookups and listeners) and rewrites the global title vector 00E196BC; register_screen still logs 004F7590 for the non-main-menu leaves.
Leaderboards register reads the Lua leaderboard table (005638F0), sets widget listeners and attaches the +34h scroller to page widgets; needs a native widget/listener model over GuiLayoutPage.
Briefing register loads the objective pages (0051DDA0) and sets the listbox listener 00A9AC40 on screen+8h; needs native listener dispatch over host widgets.
Control layout register calls the screen's +14h layout 00527F90 after its two pages; that widget binding is not bound in the menu host.
Control binding register calls its +14h 00555DC0 BindWidgets after FE_controls_PC pages; not bound in the menu host.

Constructing the attract manager publishes 00E198BC and loads FE_attract, but the host's title flow has no attract update/activation (00689E80 movie) consumer, so the manager would sit registered with no driver.
